every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 clears the text card in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D subject can occupy the full stage unobstructed, whereas Site 1's left card overlaps the anchor rack in frames 4 and 5.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same physical machine metaphor across frames 1 to 9—pressing a massive token flood into a digest, storing anchors, and routing across seven host gates.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature identical well-crafted industrial 3D models, bevels, lighting, and floor shadows across all frames from 1 to 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography is identical, Site 2's scroll pacing hides the text panel during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7, giving the 3D machinery room to breathe instead of colliding with the card like in Site 1's frame 4.

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers a cleaner scroll choreography by fading out the UI cards during camera transitions so the 3D visualization is never occluded by text.
